# Second Brain

Second Brain is a local-first personal memory layer for humans and agents. It stores memory as Markdown, preserves raw sources as evidence, and gives agents workflows to capture, ingest, search, think, lint, enrich entities, and generate diary drafts from Feishu calendar.

Repository: https://github.com/chengjialu8888/Second_brain

## Core entry points

- [README.md](README.md): Human-facing overview, value proposition, quick start, journey, architecture, roadmap.
- [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md): Chinese overview with the same quick start, journey, architecture, and positioning.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Operating protocol for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other coding agents.
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): Skill contract and workflow overview.
- [brain/RESOLVER.md](brain/RESOLVER.md): Required filing and ownership rules before creating or moving pages.
- [brain/schema.md](brain/schema.md): Entity page schema, Compiled Truth / Timeline convention, frontmatter rules.
- [brain/index.md](brain/index.md): Default brain entrypoint.
- [brain/dashboards/home.md](brain/dashboards/home.md): Obsidian-friendly human review cockpit.
- [brain/dashboards/open-questions.md](brain/dashboards/open-questions.md): Missing context and unresolved questions.
- [brain/dashboards/review-queue.md](brain/dashboards/review-queue.md): Agent-written claims and changes needing human confirmation.
- [brain/dashboards/recent-changes.md](brain/dashboards/recent-changes.md): Dated change feed for the brain.
- [skills/RESOLVER.md](skills/RESOLVER.md): Skill routing table.
- [docs/OBSIDIAN.md](docs/OBSIDIAN.md): Obsidian setup, dashboards, templates, and human review loop.

## Workflows

- [skills/brain-query.md](skills/brain-query.md): Search first, then synthesize with sources and gaps.
- [skills/agency-agent-routing.md](skills/agency-agent-routing.md): Select installed Agency Agents as specialist lenses after Second Brain evidence is read.
- [skills/chat-ingestion.md](skills/chat-ingestion.md): Preserve chat exports and extract durable entities.
- [skills/feishu-doc-ingestion.md](skills/feishu-doc-ingestion.md): Fetch Feishu docs/wiki and extract durable concepts.
- [skills/entity-enrichment.md](skills/entity-enrichment.md): Create or update canonical entity pages.
- [skills/brain-lint.md](skills/brain-lint.md): Structural and evidence-quality checks.
- [skills/calendar-diary-draft.md](skills/calendar-diary-draft.md): Generate diary drafts from Feishu calendar.

## Scripts

- `scripts/second_brain.sh help`: skill-style command surface.
- `scripts/second_brain.sh prompt`: agent startup prompt.
- `scripts/second_brain.sh search "query"`: local Markdown search through the skill-style wrapper.
- `scripts/second_brain.sh agents "query"`: search the installed Agency Agents roster for a specialist lens.
- `scripts/second_brain.sh dashboard`: print Obsidian dashboard entrypoints.
- `scripts/second_brain.sh lint`: structural lint through the skill-style wrapper.
- `scripts/second_brain.sh diary YYYY-MM-DD`: Feishu calendar to diary draft through the skill-style wrapper.
- `python3 scripts/brain_search.py "query"`: local Markdown search.
- `python3 scripts/wiki_lint.py`: structural lint.
- `scripts/calendar_diary_draft.sh YYYY-MM-DD`: Feishu calendar to diary draft.
- `scripts/extract_links.sh FILE`: extract URLs.
- `scripts/fetch_feishu_doc.sh URL`: snapshot Feishu doc/wiki.

## Specialist Agent Layer

- [agents/agency-agents/README.md](agents/agency-agents/README.md): Installed Agency Agents overview and boundaries.
- [agents/agency-agents/ROUTER.md](agents/agency-agents/ROUTER.md): Routing heuristics by deliverable type.
- [agents/agency-agents/roster.json](agents/agency-agents/roster.json): Machine-readable roster of 233 installed agents.
- [agents/agency-agents/source/](agents/agency-agents/source/): Upstream agent prompts grouped by division.
- [agents/agency-agents/strategy/](agents/agency-agents/strategy/): NEXUS multi-agent playbooks and handoffs.

## Invariants

- Filesystem Markdown is the source of truth.
- Obsidian is optional UI, not the database.
- Raw sources live under `brain/sources/` and should be treated as evidence.
- Canonical entity pages use Compiled Truth above `---` and Timeline below it.
- Agents must read `brain/RESOLVER.md` before creating or moving pages.
- Calendar-generated diary pages remain `status: draft` until the user adds subjective context.
- Agency Agents may shape deliverables only after local Second Brain evidence has been searched/read.
